claims.summary: At the distinct n5 roots (0,1,g,1-g,g^2,1-g^2) over F27 with g^3-g+1=0, the original degree-two 17x18 boundary matrix has rank16 and its normal map on all five root variations has rank1. Its actual reduced cofactor ideal is locally a dimension3 codimension2 complete intersection with tangent dimension4, hence singular. These facts persist over every extension of F27; nonreducedness is not claimed.
claims.assessment: Working computer-assisted proof. PARI constructs the literal source and analytic root derivatives; GAP independently recomputes both kernels and the pairing ranks from the retained full matrices. The existing all-odd n5 boundary theorem supplies global cofactor primitivity, hence local height2; the unit16-minor gives two local generators. Refutes a universal rank-two smoothness shortcut, not generic primitivity or the threshold formula.
claims.rationale: Route-specific exact negative control showing that the actual required codimension can hold when first-derivative transversality fails. No new threshold or independent novelty claim; the solved n5 case tests a proposed general mechanism.
claims.next_action: Use the scheduled architecture review to choose a divisor-exclusion mechanism that does not demand smoothness at every exceptional point.

relationships: The known n5,p3 primitive reduced cofactors exclude every height-one prime, determining local height2.
